system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: The detailed system prompts defining the specific behaviors and constraints for all agents are provided in Appendix A.1.
system_prompt_style.note: Per-agent system prompts described; rendering mechanism not shown.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Leveraging the open-source GraphRAG framework (Edge et al., 2024), the Parser resolves vague qualitative descriptions into quantifiable targets
env_context_strategy.note: Environment is a simulation/design space, not a repo; GraphRAG retrieval used.

observation_format.evidence_quote: the Simulator evaluates them under cross-physics constraints

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: the Generator uses MIND to propose candidates and the Simulator evaluates them under cross-physics constraints
edit_primitive.note: No file editing; actions are geometry generation and simulation.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: AutoMS adopts a two-layer architecture, with an Orchestration Layer that translates natural-language intent into quantifiable targets and coordinates agents
protocol_standardization.note: No MCP/A2A mentioned anywhere in the paper.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: a closed-loop optimization strategy that leverages simulation feedback to guide agent decision-making
loop_primitives.note: Evolutionary population search (NSGA-II selection) coded as tree_search; Manager plans then agents execute; simulation-validate-refine loop = generate_test_repair.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Upon receiving a natural language request, the Manager invokes the Parser.
planning_granularity.note: Figure 2 shows a 'GraphRAG Plan' produced by the Manager.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Governed by a Manager Agent, this layer coordinates the Parser (leveraging GraphRAG) to operationalize semantic intent into parametric targets, while the Generator, Simulator, and Reporter agents handle geometry synthesis, physical validation, and results synthesis

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Upon receiving a natural language request, the Manager invokes the Parser.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: a neuro-symbolic framework that reformulates cross-physics inverse microstructure design as an autonomous, closed-loop discovery process
human_in_loop.note: User only supplies the initial intent; no approval gate described.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: An Elite Archive A is maintained to preserve valid designs that satisfy physical constraints
short_term_state.note: History D of evaluated designs plus elite archive.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Let D={(x i,yi)}N i=1 denote the history of evaluated designs
long_term_memory.note: History is within-run only; no cross-run memory described.

self_verification.evidence_quote: the Simulator performs FEA validation (details in Appendix D)
self_verification.note: Harness-run physics simulation is the verifier, analogous to test execution.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: AutoMS iteratively refines the design candidates, resulting in optimized, topologically coherent microstructures that satisfy the initial cross-physics demands
retry_policy.note: Iterations continue until targets met; mean 14.4 iterations reported.

rollback.evidence_quote: An Elite Archive A is maintained to preserve valid designs that satisfy physical constraints, ensuring monotonicity in performance improvement.
rollback.note: Elite archive preserves candidates but no rollback of environment state.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: Efficiency: Quantifies the computational cost required for convergence, measured by Iterations (Iter) and total execution Time(s)
termination_condition.note: Iteration budget and target satisfaction; explicit caps not stated.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: the Orchestration Layer acts as an effective computational gatekeeper, preventing the wasteful simulation cycles
cost_controls.note: Efficiency discussed but no token budget/caching/routing mechanism reported.

timeouts.evidence_quote: total execution Time(s) excluding plasticity simulations
timeouts.note: Time measured, not enforced as a limit.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: The AutoMS framework is implemented in Python 3.10, with simulation engines powered by JAX-FEM (Xue et al., 2023) for cross-physics analysis.
execution_isolation.note: In-process Python/JAX-FEM execution on a cluster; no sandbox described.

network_policy.evidence_quote: LLM inference utilizes DeepSeek-V3.2 as the default backbone
network_policy.note: No network policy reported; API calls imply open egress.

permission_model.evidence_quote: By flagging high-level exceptions, including violations of physical feasibility constraints, the Manager counteracts the hallucinations inherent to open-loop LLM reasoning.
permission_model.note: Manager acts as feasibility gatekeeper over agent actions.

tracing.evidence_quote: Detailed task-specific performance and visual trajectories are documented in Appendix C.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: We designed a comprehensive suite of 17 tasks covering four orthogonal dimensions to evaluate the framework's versatility
eval_hooks.note: Benchmark and metrics (SR, CSR, MRE, BPM, QS) defined with the framework; no repo to verify.

guardrails.evidence_quote: filtering physically invalid geometries and steering the search toward feasible designs

target_domain.evidence_quote: AutoMS, a multi-agent neuro-symbolic framework that reformulates inverse design as an LLM-driven evolutionary search
target_domain.note: Domain is materials/microstructure inverse design (AI for Science).

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: LLM inference utilizes DeepSeek-V3.2 as the default backbone, with additional experiments on GPT-4o, GPT-5.2, Claude Haiku 4.5, and Qwen3-Max

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: AutoMS: Multi-Agent Evolutionary Search for Cross-Physics Inverse Microstructure Design
primary_artifact.note: No repository URL given in the evidence.
